final_findings.title: Bench Development Mode ID Hardcoding Override
final_findings.observed_behavior: BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID macro is set to 1 in code, forcing MY_TANK_ID = 1 at boot and bypassing DIP switch & Flash reads.
final_findings.impact: All slave boards boot with Tank ID 1, causing immediate bus collision and communication failure on the multi-drop UART bus.
final_findings.evidence: main.c:53 `#define BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID 1` and main.c:204 `#if (BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID > 0) MY_TANK_ID = BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID; #else ...`
final_findings.verification_method: TEST-01: Verify DIP switch reading correctly sets MY_TANK_ID.

final_findings.title: Missing Hardware Independent Watchdog (IWDG)
final_findings.observed_behavior: IWDG peripheral is not initialized or refreshed anywhere in the STM32 codebase.
final_findings.impact: If the main loop halts due to heavy industrial ESD/EMI while heater relay PB15 is HIGH, the heater remains energized, risking thermal runaway.
final_findings.evidence: Complete absence of MX_IWDG_Init or HAL_IWDG_Refresh calls in main.c and stm32g4xx_hal_conf.h.
final_findings.recommended_fix: Enable IWDG in STM32CubeMX with a 1000ms timeout and refresh in main loop.
final_findings.verification_method: TEST-02: Induce main loop freeze and confirm hardware reset within 1 second.

final_findings.title: X9C103S Interrupt Blackout in Microsecond Stepping
final_findings.observed_behavior: __disable_irq() masks global interrupts for up to 600 microseconds during wiper adımlama.
final_findings.impact: Causes UART RX character loss (Overrun Error) and misses zero-cross EXTI edges, causing triac phase firing timing jitter.
final_findings.evidence: x9c103s.c:31 `__disable_irq()` followed by a 100-iteration loop calling `X9C_DelayUs(3U)` twice per step.
final_findings.recommended_fix: Remove global interrupt disable around the entire step loop; execute wiper pulses asynchronously.
final_findings.verification_method: TEST-03: Measure UART RX error counter and zero-cross interrupt jitter.

final_findings.title: ESP32 Boot Time Slave Availability Logic Flaw
final_findings.observed_behavior: stm_son_veri_zamani[] array is initialized to 0. For the first 3000ms after boot, `(millis() - 0) < 3000` evaluates to true.
final_findings.impact: Master considers all non-existent slave tanks as connected for the first 3 seconds after power-on, allowing START commands to be sent to offline tanks.
final_findings.verification_method: TEST-04: Attempt to trigger START within 1 second of power-on without connected slaves.

final_findings.title: Hardcoded 50Hz AC Half-Cycle Assumption
final_findings.observed_behavior: AC_HALF_CYCLE_US is hardcoded to 10000us (50Hz) and TRIAC_MAX_DELAY_US to 9500us.
final_findings.impact: When operated on 60Hz mains (8333us half-cycle), firing delays >8333us are reset by zero-cross EXTI before firing, causing cut-off in low power modes.
final_findings.recommended_fix: Measure actual zero-cross period dynamically using input capture or EXTI tick differences.
final_findings.verification_method: Simulate 60Hz zero-cross signals and observe triac gate pulse generation.

final_findings.title: Unrestricted T0: Broadcast Address Execution in RUNNING Mode
final_findings.observed_behavior: T0:SET_ID broadcast command is processed during RUNNING state, executing blocking Flash page erase (20-40ms).
final_findings.impact: Receiving a broadcast ID change while running stalls CPU execution, missing zero-cross interrupts and corrupting process state.
final_findings.recommended_fix: Restrict `T0:` broadcast handling exclusively to IDLE mode.
final_findings.verification_method: TEST-06: Send `T0:SET_ID:2` during active process and observe rejection.

final_findings.title: STM32 Single-Line UART Buffer and Burst Dropping
final_findings.observed_behavior: Single rx_line buffer drops incoming UART bytes while line_ready is 1.
final_findings.impact: Rapid burst commands sent from ESP32 master are silently dropped on STM32 slave side.
final_findings.evidence: esp32_uart.c:271 `/* if line_ready is still set... incoming bytes are dropped */`.
final_findings.recommended_fix: Implement a circular buffer (ring FIFO) for UART RX lines.
final_findings.verification_method: Send 5 rapid consecutive commands over UART and verify all 5 are parsed.

final_findings.title: ESP32 HMI Handler Blocking Delays
final_findings.observed_behavior: HMI save handlers execute blocking delay(400) and delay(600) calls for UI button color animation.
final_findings.impact: Blocks main loop for up to 600ms, stalling UART telemetry reception and causing RX buffer overflows.
final_findings.recommended_fix: Replace delay() with a non-blocking millis() timer state machine.
final_findings.verification_method: Confirm main loop latency remains below 1ms during save operations.
